plugins.name: agentrmc-bridge
plugins.description: AgentRMC pet bridge for ZCode / WorkBuddy / Qoder: auto bubble and voice alerts when the agent waits for approval, waits for a choice, or finishes a task, plus MCP tools to report progress, make the pet speak and query pet state. WorkBuddy and WorkBuddy AI are separate installs; install the plugin in each.

description_i18n.zh-CN: AgentRMC 桌宠联动：等授权、等选方案时桌宠自动气泡加语音提醒并把 Agent 窗口带回前台；任务完成的提醒点一下气泡也能回去。支持 WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI 双宿主各自安装，还能让桌宠汇报进度、说一句话、查状态。
